SSM-XR5340LA OROCHI is a back-mounted Skell weapon in Xenoblade Chronicles X as the only member of the OROCHI Series of weapons. It can only be equipped on the right side (despite being named as if it's a shoulder-mounted weapon) and takes both slots. This weapon has a chance to appear after beating the Squad Mission The Warlord's Challenge or the Time Attack mission The Wrothian Samurai. When sourced from the Vasara in the main story, this weapon comes with randomly-selected Battle Traits. When it comes from Network Console Missions, the traits are fixed. This weapon comes with a unique Art, Sunburst Agony.

Score Attack is a gameplay mode in Xenoblade Chronicles: Definitive Edition – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition as part of the Nopon Grand Prix, where characters on Ether Jets roam maps dotted with ether ore, checkpoints, and enemies. The aim is to run through each checkpoint before the time limit ends, while smashing into the ether ore to collect as many points as possible. Score Attack unlocks once the party leaves the Ether Mine, as long as Ether Jets have been unlocked by completing World-Changing Whatchamajig.
